paragraphs: NotLost sells lost property management software that organisations use to register and return lost items. The company describes the product as SaaS technology for the identification and enquiry management of physical items.

A photo of a found item starts an automated process that generates a report cataloguing the item. A matching engine matches customer enquiries with found items. End customers can purchase postage labels for the return of their items through integrated courier services.
Their software is described as configurable for sectors ranging from small hotels to Transport for London.
